story.title: TCU fires Sonny Dykes four years after making CFP championship game
story.summary: The move came a day after a 38-17 loss to No. 2 Utah in its home finale. Updated on: November 22, 2026 / 12:51 PM CST / CBS/AP CBS Sports Texas has independently confirmed that Texas Christian University fired head football coach Sonny Dykes, four years after Dykes led the Horned Frogs to a CFP championship game in his first season in Fort Worth. The Horned Frogs were just 5-6 a day after a 38-17 loss to No. 2 Utah in its home finale. The Frogs' five losses before that had all been one-score games against Power Four opponents, and by a combined 25 points. The Frogs were coming off back-to-back 9-4 seasons when Dykes got a multi-year extension in April. He finished 41-23 at TCU. The Frogs (5-6, 3-5 Big 12) could still get bowl-eligible if they win their regular-season finale Thanksgiving night at defending Big 12 champion Texas Tech (10-1, 7-1).
